name: JSW Dulux Ltd
title: JSW Dulux Ltd - 500710 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Volume up 23% but revenue only 6.2% on price cuts and mix; price hikes of ~9.7% against ~13.5% raw-material pass-through need, with 3-4% still to take and margins at risk.

utilisation.quote: we operate anywhere between 55% to 60% on decorative paints

capex.quote: we are going to be see investing in the capex . Again, other things being equal, we are to sort of look at capacity expansion and localization

triggers.label: Decorative utilisation 55-60%
triggers.quote: we operate anywhere between 55% to 60% on decorative paints

triggers.label: Price hikes 9.7% vs 13.5% RM need
triggers.quote: we would have taken close to about 9.7% of price increase

triggers.label: Volume growth 23% in Q4
triggers.quote: We've had a record volume growth of 23%, both on the decorative and industrial vertic als.

triggers.label: Dealer pre-buy in March
triggers.quote: dealer pre-buy is to an extent of some times a week to 10 days

triggers.label: Margin compression possible FY27
triggers.quote: we'll see a bit of compression maybe for a quarter on the margins

guidance.quote: we are looking and targeting a double-digit growth

guidance.value: become strong number 3 in decorative from 4
guidance.quote: At least becoming a strong number 3 player to start with from 4

red_flags.label: Dealer pre-buy inflating Q4 volume
red_flags.quote: dealer pre-buy is to an extent of some times a week to 10 days

red_flags.label: Margin compression ahead on RM inflation
red_flags.quote: we'll see a bit of compression maybe for a quarter on the margins

evasions.quote: That's the toughest question for me to answer now because let's understand what's happening today is very unpredictable.
I don't think it's fair for me to comment on the names, et c.
